passages.quote: In the waning four hundred years of the First Age of Middle-earth, the shadow of Morgoth still lingers in the land of Beleriand, while he and his malevolent host remain hidden within the besieged fortress of Angband. You and your fellowship of Dungeoneers: mighty heroes, agile wanderers, and wise scholars, volunteer to venture into the ruins and wilds tainted by his enduring malice, seeking to aid the Valar in eradicating his influence and healing the land.

While the great events of the First Age unfold beyond your sight, you may partake in them and forge your own path by exploring the rapidly changing story of the long-gone and sea-sunken northwestern regions of Middle-earth, many thousands of years before the War of the Ring, when the Gods still walked among mortals, the Elves were young, the Dwarves carved their first great halls, and the sons of Men had only just awakened to the world.

In the depths of these ancient dungeons, fierce menaces and the whispers of evil festering in the dark through orcs and other fell beings guard treasures and powers long forgotten. Your quest is not for glory alone, but for the preservation of what light remains in Middle-earth and its future generations.

First Age Middle-Earth Dungeoneers (F.A.M-E.D.) is a deck-building cooperative adventure game with fast-paced tactical combat, combining two layers of gameplay: surface exploration across the landscape and underground dungeon crawling, all set during the fading centuries of the First Age of Middle-earth. Players lead a fellowship of heroes (1 to 4) across Beleriand, revealing hex-based regions, resolving narrative-driven quests, exploring dungeons, and confronting the lingering evils of Morgoth to receive rewards and loot.

Each player manages a unique miniature connected to a deck containing artifacts, consumables, and skills divided into physical prowess, magical wit, and craftsmanship utility, representing your hero defined by their chosen heritage and playstyle. The hero deck is used to interact with all actions: exploration, quests, events, encounters, and the discovery of hidden lore for extra treasures.
